title: Superheater
model_title: Pendant Superheater (Primary + Secondary with Spray Attemperator)

introduction.definition: A superheater raises the temperature of saturated steam from the boiler drum above its saturation temperature. Superheated steam carries more energy per kilogram and stays dry through most of the turbine. Pendant platens hang in the hottest gas path; an attemperator sprays feedwater between stages to hold the final temperature.
applications: Process steam where dry steam is required
key_points: Highest metal temperatures in the boiler → alloy steels
Steam flow cools the tubes — never fire without steam flow

classification.type: Two-stage pendant superheater with interstage attemperator

introduction.summary: A superheater heats saturated steam from the boiler drum above its saturation temperature. Dry superheated steam improves turbine efficiency and avoids blade erosion. Pendant tube platens hang in the hot gas path; a spray attemperator between the primary and secondary stages controls the final steam temperature.

steps.text: Saturated steam from the drum enters the primary inlet header.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Convective superheaters: outlet temperature rises with load; radiant: falls with load — designs combine both for a flatter curve.

temperature.title: Gas temperature falls across the pass
temperature.description: Flue gas enters at very high temperature and gives heat first to the secondary and then the primary stage. The final steam temperature is held at its set-point by spraying feedwater in the attemperator between the stages; tube metal temperature (not gas temperature) limits the materials used (alloy steels such as T22/T91).

video_tutorials.title: Superheater — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Superheater.
A superheater raises the temperature of saturated steam from the boiler drum above its saturation temperature.
Superheated steam carries more energy per kilogram and stays dry through most of the turbine.
Pendant platens hang in the hottest gas path; an attemperator sprays feedwater between stages to hold the final temperature.
Typical applications include utility and industrial water-tube boilers; HRSGs; process steam where dry steam is required.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Horizontal Gas Pass (boiler back-pass casing).
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: How the Superheater works.
Saturated steam from the drum enters the primary inlet header.
The primary platens heat the steam in the cooler gas zone.
The attemperator sprays water to trim the temperature.
The secondary platens heat the steam to its final temperature.
Superheated steam leaves to the turbine.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Flue gas enters at very high temperature and gives heat first to the secondary and then the primary stage.

video_tutorials.title: Superheater — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Superheater.
Monitor steam and tube metal temperatures; spray flow.
Inspect for sagging, erosion and slag.
Oxide scale and creep assessment; replace aged sections.
Watch for long-term overheating (creep): bulging, thick-lip ruptures. Common cause: internal oxide scale, high metal temperature.
Watch for attemperator liner cracking: cracks at spray zone. Common cause: thermal shock.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
